about_the_game:
Welcome to Soulcoom, a 2.5D story-rich erotic RPG and fantasy physics sandbox.

You are Pollenhorn—a rare Fate whose fertile presence stirs primal instincts across the floating aerlands of Mid-Sky. Maidens swoon, matrons bloom, and the world leans in, aching to be near you.

Your mouse is your wand. Your choices are spells. Shape destinies, shift hearts, and alter fate.

In this Early Access build, explore the first mythic region of our sky-realm, experiment with our Fantasy Physics engine, lose yourself in healing soundscapes, and master the 4 humors of persuasion in our emergent Dialogue Battle System.

🎭 Story Mode (Early Access)

  • Awaken as Pollenhorn in a secluded cloud-top cottage, surrounded by an all-female cast.

  • Engage in turn-based dialogue battles where emotional persuasion replaces violence.

  • Uncover fragments of the greater mythos, encounter your first companion, and shape your story through choice.

  • More content, companions, and branching purity/corruption arcs are planned post-launch.

🔥 Simulation Mode (Fully Functional Sandbox)

  • Experience our signature Fantasy Physics Sex Sim, powered by reactive 2D kinetic motion.

  • Build and customize your muse with layered editing and unlockable options.

  • Experiment freely in a hand-animated sandbox designed for discovery and expression.

⚙️ Features Available Now

  • ✅ A True Successor to Super Deep Throat – Classic Flash Animation inspiration with modern precision, reimagined in our hand-drawn engine

  • ✅ Dialogue Battle System – A turn-based persuasion game where emotional humors replace violence

  • ✅ Choices That Matter – Your actions shape personality, unlock dialogue paths, and shift power dynamics

  • ✅ Fantasy Physics Simulation – A fully hand-animated sandbox with real-time 2D motion and reactive bodies

  • ✅ Deep Character Customization – Layered editing tools to personalize your muse in the sandbox

  • ✅ Rich Audio Design – Immersive, healing soundscapes crafted for both relaxation and depth

  • ✅ International Voice Actresses – Over 15+ adult voice talents bring emotional nuance and intimacy

  • ✅ 9,000+ Hand-Drawn Sprites – Fully illustrated expressions, reactions, and animations

  • ❗ More areas, arcs, and companions are actively in development!

content_descriptors.notes: This game features explicit 2.5D animated sex scenes, customizable genitals, suggestive dialogue battles, and erotic simulations using reactive Fantasy Physics. Players engage with an all-female cast in a branching story shaped by desire, corruption, and seduction.
